title: Incitant
body:
Super adaptable pour que ça réponde à chacun
Donne envie de le compléter 
Permet d’avoir un regard sur sa vie, ses habitudes, ses émotions, ses ressentis (corps esprit)

Très intuitif et motivant
author: Pauliliine

title: Thiefs!!!
body: I deleted my account and the data during my first 3 month subscription but that didn’t keep them of billing me through Paypal for a renewal after that. I contacted them for a refund but they refuse to give me my money back even though I don’t have any interest of using this subscription. Ugly way of taking some extra money. Not a very understanding company I would say.
author: Celine_3105
